claude_proposed_widenings.name: DcSource.fixed
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item casts an existing spell but overrides its save DC to a fixed value. The current surface can express caster-derived, weapon-derived, and innate ability DCs, but not an item-specified fixed DC.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast Lightning Bolt (save DC 15) from it

claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.attunementRestriction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic items currently record only a boolean attunement flag. This item further restricts attunement eligibility to spellcasters, which cannot be expressed without losing a real rule on the record.
